title: What's behind this month's fallen tech giants? ServiceNow is down 30%,Arm 23%, Lam 20%.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Some of tech's biggest names just had an ugly month. ServiceNow is  
down about 30% since its Oct 29 earnings selloff, Arm lost 23% after  
an earnings miss, and Lam Research fell 20% despite record results.  
Here's today's look at the hardest-hit tech giants, and what has to go  
right for a bounce.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. ServiceNow (NOW)\*\* — ServiceNow (NOW) shares have declined  
roughly 30% over the past 30 days, driven by a historic post-earnings  
selloff on October 29.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/servicenow-now-slides-30-in-30-days-after-q3-earnings-miss-39444/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/servicenow-now-slides-30-in-30-days-after-q3-earnings-miss-39444/)  
  
\*\*2. Arm (ARM)\*\* — Arm Holdings (ARM) shares fell roughly 23% over the  
trailing 30 days, sliding from about $227.80 (October 16 close) to  
around $175.03.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/arm-holdings-arm-stock-falls-23-in-30-days-earnings-miss-and-sector-reset-39440/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/arm-holdings-arm-stock-falls-23-in-30-days-earnings-miss-and-sector-reset-39440/)  
  
\*\*3. Lam Research (LRCX)\*\* — Lam Research (LRCX) fell roughly 20% over  
the last 30 days, from about $263.94 to $210.83, extending a sharp  
multi-month pullback in semiconductor equipment shares.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/lam-research-lrcx-declines-20-over-30-days-despite-record-results-39443/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/lam-research-lrcx-declines-20-over-30-days-despite-record-results-39443/)  
  
\*\*4. GlobalFoundries (GFS)\*\* — GlobalFoundries shares fell about 15.6%  
over the last 30 days, declining from roughly $46.68 to $39.42 and  
extending a broader multi-month downtrend.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/globalfoundries-gfs-drops-15-6-over-30-days-despite-q3-earnings-beat-39470/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/globalfoundries-gfs-drops-15-6-over-30-days-despite-q3-earnings-beat-39470/)  
  
\*\*5. Sasol (SSL)\*\* — Sasol (SSL) declined roughly 14.8% over the 30  
days to mid-November 2026, falling from about $16.34 to $13.92 as a  
powerful autumn rally reversed.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sasol-ssl-declines-14-8-over-30-days-as-oil-prices-ease-39650/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sasol-ssl-declines-14-8-over-30-days-as-oil-prices-ease-39650/)  
  
\*\*6. Falcon's Beyond Global (FBYD)\*\* — FBYD shares declined about 36%  
over the 30 days through mid-November 2026, sliding from a closing  
price of $8.32 to $5.30. The sell-off accelerated after third-quarter  
2026 results reported on November 12, which showed a $7.7 million net  
loss and a $1.94 million cash balance despite 80% revenue growth.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/falcon-s-beyond-global-fbyd-slides-36-over-30-days-on-earnings-concerns-39476/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/falcon-s-beyond-global-fbyd-slides-36-over-30-days-on-earnings-concerns-39476/)  
  
\*\*7. Arvinas (ARVN)\*\* — Arvinas (ARVN) trades near $6.77, down roughly  
2.9% over the last 30 days and about 26% lower over the trailing  
quarter. Arvinas pioneered PROTAC targeted protein degradation, and  
its VEPPANU (vepdegestrant) became the first FDA-approved PROTAC  
therapy in May 2026.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/arvinas-arvn-down-26-this-quarter-pipeline-catalysts-after-veppanu-approval-39469/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/arvinas-arvn-down-26-this-quarter-pipeline-catalysts-after-veppanu-approval-39469/)  
  
Would you buy any of these fallen names here, or is the damage still unfolding?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
